translations.1: Seoyoon, are you still at the office?
translations.10: I'm leaving Bori at a pet hotel on Saturday. The booking form wanted an English name, so I put Barley lol.
translations.11: Hahaha I can never remember if Barley's a boy or a girl.
translations.12: She's a girl. Three years old and still shy around strangers.
translations.13: Take it easy on Sunday once the move's done. I want to see Barley too lol. Want to get brunch?
translations.14: Sounds good! Hyejin's coming Sunday to help me get things in order.
translations.15: Oh nice. So Barley will be back home by then, right?
translations.16: Yeah, my older brother's bringing her over Sunday morning.
translations.17: That's a relief. Should we invite Subin too?
translations.18: I asked, but Subin can't come on Sunday. He said he already has plans.
translations.19: Too bad. Oh, how do I spell the new hire Chaeyul's name in English? I have to send a calendar invite.
translations.2: Yeah ㅠㅠ the meeting won't end. Jiu, did you already leave?
translations.20: They said to write it Chaeyul. Not 'Chaeyool' lol.
translations.21: Okay. What are you doing with the sofa? Barley slept on it all the time.
translations.22: I listed it on Karrot and got a message right away. We're meeting tomorrow evening to hand it over.
translations.23: Wow, that was fast. Seoyoon, you really loved that sofa.
translations.24: True ㅠㅠ But the new place is small, so I had no choice.
translations.25: Did you get your old deposit back? The landlady was pretty strict, wasn't she?
translations.26: Not yet ㅠㅠ I was told to clean properly, so I have to scrub everything before Sunday.
translations.27: Ugh, Sunday's supposed to be a rest day. Let's make Chaeyul do it lol.
translations.28: I know. She said she'll transfer the deposit right after the inspection.
translations.29: My older brother used to work at a moving company. Want me to ask him for tips?
translations.3: I just left. By the way, did the lease go through okay?
translations.30: Oh really? Does he still do it?
translations.31: Nope, he quit last year and runs a cafe now. He'll still give us tips though.
translations.32: Thanks lol. Jiu, did you send the Monday meeting invite to Chaeyul too?
translations.33: Yep, just sent it. By the way, is Barley okay riding in a car?
translations.34: She runs away the second she sees the carrier lol. I'll have to lure her in with treats.
translations.4: Yeah, I signed yesterday. It's really over now.
translations.6: I know ㅠㅠ there's so much to do.
translations.7: Did you book a full-service move?
translations.8: Nope lol, semi-packed. I'm moving on Saturday and I have to pack my own stuff.
